Recalled, not checked: Abdul Alim, Nina Hamid ('Aji Dhire Bolao Gari Garial', a gariyal song on iTunes), Nirmalendu Chowdhury ('Sagar Kuler Naiya Re'), Bari Siddiqui and Kafiluddin Sarkar as bhawaiya or bhatiali singers; no page found tying their tracks to the genre.
Abbasuddin Ahmed's 'Torsa Nadir Dhare Dhare' (Saregama 'Allah Megh De', dated 1940 on iTunes) is very likely bhawaiya (Torsa is a Cooch Behar river) but no page names its genre.
